_about: Hand tuning of the hats (docs/art/cosmetics.md). Wins over fit_auto.json, which tools/import_cosmetics.sh rewrites from the hat sheets. Per hat: width (hat width in head widths, front view), sink (how far the hat's bottom edge dips below the top of the hair, head widths), dx / dy (nudge, head widths), scale; any of them per direction as <key>_<DIR>, e.g. sink_SIDE, dx_BACK. Setting sink here also replaces the importer's per-direction sinks.

LEAFCROWN._note: Oct 29 redo: the wreath sat on top of the hair; sunk to the brow (eyes clear in every direction) and a little narrower.
